items.a: We are a financial technology company focused on developing proprietary trading algorithms with neural networks for the crypto market. Operating since 2018, with our first profitable version in 2020.

items.q: How does the Polar One system work?
items.a: It is a fully automated trading system that uses two types of neural networks — trend and direction — to identify opportunities and execute high-frequency, low-latency trades on Binance.

Crypto trading involves significant risks, including volatility, market, regulatory, liquidity and technological risks. You may lose part or all of your capital. We strongly recommend seeking independent financial advice.

We charge a one-time 10% license fee on the deposited amount and a performance fee (20% to 30% depending on the plan) only on profits generated. Profits are distributed weekly, every Friday at 23:00 UTC.
We accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and USDT. Withdrawals are processed automatically 24/7 in USDT and USDC.
